question: calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T2.district, (CAST(T2.anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(T2.pregnancies_registered, 0) * 100.0) - (CAST(T1.anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.pregnancies_registered, 0) * 100.0) AS percentage_point_difference FROM anc_visits AS T1 JOIN anc_visits AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district WHERE T1.year = 2021 AND T2.year = 2023 AND T1.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')

```sql
SELECT
  T2.district,
  (CAST(T2.anc4_completed AS FLOAT) / T2.pregnancies_registered * 100.0) - (CAST(T1.anc4_completed AS FLOAT) / T1.pregnancies_registered * 100.0) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM anc_visits AS T1
JOIN anc_visits AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district
WHERE T1.year = 2021 AND T2.year = 2023 AND T1.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda');
```
